content.short: DeltaDefi is a Cardano DEX built around Hydra scaling, order-book trading, and fast DeFi execution on-chain.
content.description: DeltaDefi is a decentralized exchange project built around Hydra, Cardano's layer-2 scaling framework. The platform aims to bring high-performance trading to Cardano by using an order-book model that feels familiar to traditional market participants while still operating in a DeFi context. By leveraging Hydra's architecture, DeltaDefi focuses on faster execution, better responsiveness, and a path toward higher-frequency trading on Cardano. Its purpose is to bridge professional trading patterns with native Cardano liquidity.
